summary: Added a dedicated floating dependency triage command so existing latest/open-ended specs can be listed independently of the broader supply-chain gate.

changes.details: Reads package.json and prints dependencies/devDependencies with highly floating specs plus recommended next steps.
Requires supply-chain:floating-deps to remain present and wired to scripts/security/list-floating-dependencies.mjs.
Documented the floating dependency triage command and added it to the dependency-change checklist.

remaining: Run npm run supply-chain:lockfile with npm@10.8.2 and commit package-lock.json after review.
Use npm-audit-triage artifact to update vulnerable packages precisely.
Replace floating dependency specs with exact audited lockfile-resolved versions.
